items.quote: Please stop asking this question when you are trying to establish authority of your client.
items.statement: Stop asking if the client is the decision maker when establishing authority.

items.quote: How many deals are lost just because the client are pitching, presenting, and then hoping for decisions from person who is not a decision maker altogether.
items.statement: Many deals are lost because the presenter hopes for decisions from non-decision makers.

items.quote: if you want to learn which questions you will need to...
items.statement: Instead of asking if they are the decision maker, ask about the decision-making process.

overview: Discussion on client engagement and decision-making in sales, presented in a casual manner.
